statusBanner.openTitle: No rule is defined — the mesh is open
statusBanner.openDesc: Node enforcement is default-deny, so an empty policy delivered to the fleet would stop all traffic. The control plane compiles allow-all while this table is empty: every node may reach every other. Writing the first rule closes the mesh to everything it does not permit.

defaultPolicyCard.openExpl: Unmatched mesh traffic between non-quarantined peers is permitted by default.
defaultPolicyCard.denyExpl: Strict Zero-Trust: all unmatched traffic is silently dropped by the TUN filter.
defaultPolicyCard.confirmDesc: Switching organization default policy to {{policy}} will advance the mesh epoch and immediately alter filtering on all fleet nodes. Are you sure you wish to proceed?
